description: admin grants sqlspecificadmintest a DSN-specific dsns_auth record for dsn-sq{{PERMTESTID}} -- not an identity-level permission. Includes read+write alongside admin: AuthDSN's bitmask check has no 'admin implies read/write' shortcut the way IdentityAuthorizesAction does, and @sql opens the DSN with the combined DSNWriteAction+DSNReadAction regardless of statement kind (sql.go), so admin-only would fail at the DSN-open stage before ever reaching the UsageAdmin check this test is actually about.
